body: GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DEMO DISCORD Introduction In early April, we introduced CodeQwen1.5, which garnered significant attention from the community. Since then, we have been working to enhance the coding model. Today, we are excited to announce the release of the next generation of open-source coding models, Qwen2.5-Coder, and officially rename CodeQwen to Qwen-Coder. We think “Coder” is more human-like and agile, reflecting our vision of it becoming a true coding partner in the future.
summaryZh: 本文宣布推出新一代开源代码大模型 Qwen2.5-Coder，并将原 CodeQwen 正式更名为 Qwen-Coder。该系列模型旨在打造更具敏捷性和人类特质的编程伙伴，在代码生成、代码修复及软件开发辅助任务上展现出业界领先的性能，为开发者社区提供了强大的开源编程助手工具。
